text.content: 2026-08-17 - R8 B128 utilization probe passed with marginal throughput gain

The B128/rank, global-1024 probe completed 100 finite steps on 8 B200s and exited 0. Mean throughput was 163.535 samples/s versus the approximately 160 samples/s R7 reference; peak memory reached 96,500 MiB per GPU while average GPU utilization remained 63.01%-67.31%. The complete 8-rank step-100 checkpoint is 93,930,527,997 bytes. Terminal aligned/zero/shuffle action losses were 0.0083108954/0.0093276529/0.0091043524, so correct aligned history improved action loss by 10.90046%/8.71514%. All gates passed, but the throughput increase was only marginal; one bounded B192 probe will determine whether higher occupancy improves useful throughput before the 20k formal configuration is fixed.
